title: Scrum Master Project Manager Oracle Apps Technical
description:
* Experience with Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), WebMethods, or other middleware technologies.
* Exposure to Azure integration services, REST APIs, and cloud-based integration platforms.
* Scrum Master certification such as PSM or CSM.
* PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams across multiple geographical regions.
* Experience in production support, incident management, change management, and release governance.

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership and team coordination.
* Effective meeting facilitation and conflict resolution.
* Ability to drive accountability and delivery ownership.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to balance project management responsibilities with technical understanding.
* Proactive risk identification and issue resolution.
* Focus on quality, continuous improvement, and predictable delivery.

**Success Criteria**

* Consistent achievement of sprint and project delivery commitments.
* Improved sprint planning, estimation, and execution.
* Timely identification and resolution of project risks and dependencies.
* Improved quality and readiness of JIRA stories.
* Effective coordination between business, development, QA, and support teams.
* Successful delivery of Oracle Apps Technical enhancements and integration projects.
* High stakeholder satisfaction through transparent communication and reporting.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A technically strong professional with Oracle Apps Technical experience who can effectively combine Scrum Master responsibilities, project coordination, Agile delivery management, and stakeholder communication to drive successful project outcomes.

  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
  

We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong combination of
**Scrum Master, Project Management, and Oracle Apps Technical expertise**
to lead technical delivery, manage Agile teams, and coordinate integration projects.

The candidate will be responsible for facilitating Scrum ceremonies, managing sprint execution, tracking project milestones, coordinating with business and technical stakeholders, and ensuring timely delivery of Oracle EBS technical enhancements and integration solutions.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Oracle Apps Technical, a good understanding of Oracle EBS, and the ability to manage development teams while driving Agile delivery and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Scrum Master Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders.
* Track sprint progress, story points, team velocity, and sprint commitments.
* Identify and remove impediments affecting sprint execution and delivery.
* Ensure JIRA stories have clear requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and estimates before development begins.
* Monitor sprint scope, delivery commitments, and team performance.
* Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement across the team.

**2. Project Management Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end delivery of Oracle Apps Technical and integration projects.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, and delivery roadmaps.
* Track project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with business teams, solution architects, technical teams, QA, infrastructure, and production support.
* Provide regular project status reports to management and stakeholders.
* Manage scope changes, escalations, resource constraints, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, production deployment, and post-deployment support.
* Ensure adherence to project governance, code review, testing, and release management processes.
* Drive effective communication across geographically distributed teams and multiple business regions.

**3. Oracle Apps Technical Responsibilities**

* Possess strong technical knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), preferably R12.
* Understand Oracle Apps Technical components, including:
* Oracle PL/SQL, SQL, Packages, Procedures, Functions, and Triggers.
* Concurrent Programs, Executables, and Requests.
* Oracle Reports, XML Publisher / BI Publisher, and Interfaces.
* Oracle Workflow and APIs.
* Data migration, validation, and reconciliation.
* Have a good understanding of Oracle EBS modules such as Order Management, Purchasing, Inventory, and Accounts Payable.
* Understand integration requirements between Oracle EBS and external applications.
* Review technical designs, solution approaches, development estimates, and implementation plans.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve technical issues and ensure the quality of deliverables.
* Participate in technical discussions, impact assessments, root cause analysis, and solution reviews.
* Ensure technical documentation, deployment plans, and support handover documents are maintained.

**4. Integration and Delivery Coordination**

* Coordinate integration development and enhancement activities involving Oracle EBS and external systems.
* Understand integration technologies such as Oracle SOA Suite, REST APIs, SOAP services, EDI, and middleware platforms.
* Work with technical teams on interface design, mapping, data validation, and error handling.
* Manage dependencies between application teams, integration teams, and external partners.
* Ensure integrations are adequately tested and ready for production deployment.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 8–15 years of overall IT experience.
* Strong experience in Scrum Master and/or Technical Project Management responsibilities.
* Good hands-on experience in Oracle Apps Technical and Oracle EBS R12.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Experience using JIRA for sprint planning, backlog management, story tracking, and reporting.
* Good understanding of project planning, estimation, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience managing technical development teams and cross-functional delivery.
* Understanding of SDLC, SIT, UAT, production deployment, and support processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and senior management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within agreed timelines.

title: Lead, Tech PM
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Technical Project Manager**
to lead the to lead strategic technology initiatives within the
**Corporate Applications Technology (CAT) Business Unit**
under
**Global Engineering**
.
  
  
The role will support planning, execution, and delivery of technology initiatives across cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong project management capabilities with technical understanding to drive successful delivery, manage risks, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
  
  
**Experience Range:**
8-15 years
  
  
**Role Level:**
Lead Tech PM
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of technology projects from initiation through production deployment.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and resource allocation.
* Track project progress and ensure milestones are delivered on time and within scope.
* Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks, issues, and roadblocks.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business leaders, product owners, architects, engineering teams, QA teams, and external vendors.
* Facilitate project governance meetings, status reviews, and executive updates.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and drive alignment across teams.

**Technical Leadership**

* Work closely with engineering and architecture teams to understand solution design and technical dependencies.
* Review technical deliverables, release plans, and deployment schedules.
* Support technical decision-making through data-driven project insights.
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards, security, compliance, and operational requirements.

**Agile Program Management**

* Drive Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Monitor team velocity and delivery metrics.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and facilitate resolution of impediments.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Provide regular project health reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.
* Track scope, schedule, cost, quality, and delivery metrics.
* Ensure project documentation is maintained, and audit/compliance requirements are met.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in Project Management with at least 3 years managing complex technology initiatives.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience managing Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery models.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certification.
* Experience working with enterprise applications, digital transformation, or regulatory/compliance programs.
* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, testing, release management, and production support processes.

**Technical Skills**

* Agile / Scrum / Kanban
* Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Clarity, MS Project
* SDLC, Release Management, Change Management
* Risk & Issue Management
* Budget & Resource Planning
* Executive Reporting & Governance
* Vendor Management

**Key Competencies**

* Financial management
* Vendor Management
* Leadership and influence
* Strategic thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Communication and presentation skills
* Decision making
* Conflict resolution
* Team collaboration and coaching

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Project Analyst

title: Technical Delivery Lead / Engineering Lead (Java)
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction:
**AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value:
**we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow:
**understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a
**Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

**Role Details**

📍
**Job location:**
Pune (Hybrid — 3 days per week in the office)

🕒
**Contract type:**
Employee

🗓
**Target start date:**
ASAP

⏰
**Working hours:**
Full-time (40h/week), 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST

💵
**Compensation:**
₹35,00,000 – ₹50,00,000 per year

**📋 What You'll Architect**

At Keyrus, we transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining
**technology, data, intelligence and human decision-making**
.

We’re looking for an experienced
**Technical Delivery Lead**
to contribute to a strategic enterprise modernisation programme for a global financial services client. This is a highly hands-on role, with approximately
**80% focused on coding and technical implementation and 20% on technical leadership**
.

You will combine
**hands-on technical expertise with team leadership**
, guiding a Pune-based development team while working closely with stakeholders and distributed teams across APAC, EMEA and the US.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor the development team, providing technical direction and best practices.
* Stay hands-on with Java, Spring Boot and microservices, contributing to architecture, coding and code reviews.
* Design and guide cloud-native solutions using Azure, Docker and Kubernetes/AKS.
* Drive technical delivery across both legacy modernisation and new technology initiatives.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate the roadmap into clear technical priorities and delivery plans.
* Coordinate across Agile teams and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery timelines.
* Promote strong engineering practices across CI/CD, DevOps and infrastructure automation.
* Contribute to the design and optimisation of ETL/data pipelines, Snowflake solutions and Kafka-based messaging.
* Support team development, performance and alignment across international time zones.

**👤 Who You Are**

* You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges.
* You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action.
* You balance technical thinking with business understanding.
* You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments.
* You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.
* You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders.

**🛠️ What You Bring**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years of software development experience, including at least 5 years in a technical leadership role.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Core Java, Java 8+, Spring Boot and microservices architecture.
* Proven experience with REST APIs and enterprise application development.
* Strong cloud experience with Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes/AKS.
* Experience with Docker and cloud-native application deployment.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams and deliver enterprise-scale initiatives in an Agile environment.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across distributed international teams.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience with Snowflake and ETL/data pipelines, including technologies such as Airflow, Spring Batch or Apache Camel.
* Experience with Kafka or other enterprise messaging platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps.
* Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure-as-Code.
* Financial Services / Banking experience.
* Knowledge of SQL, NoSQL/Cosmos DB, Unix scripting or monitoring tools.
* GitHub Copilot or other AI-powered development tools, Terraform/IaC, and Financial Services experience.

**⭐ What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism.
* You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions.
* You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* You combine autonomy with collaboration.
* You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results.

**🎁 What We Offer at Keyrus UK**

* Hybrid work model (3 days/week in the office)
* 18 paid leaves + 9 public holidays
* ₹5L medical insurance + ₹10L accident insurance
* Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
* International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
* Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Referral Bonus Scheme
* Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

**💰 How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect
**different levels of mastery and impact within the same role**
— not different job titles.

* Bottom of the range You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* Middle of the range You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* Top of the range You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on
**experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**
, and are discussed transparently during the process.

**🔒 Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**

To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for
**note-taking purposes during interviews**
. AI is
**never**
used to make decisions.

To ensure
**fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**

**strictly prohibited**
.

Our commitment to
**responsible AI practices**
ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

⚠️
**Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

**♿ Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

At
**Keyrus**
, we help organisations move from experimental AI to industrialised AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an
**Architect of Intelligence**
. Designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value:
**we operationalise intelligence**
.

Powered by our proprietary
**Human Orchestrated Model™**
(HOM), we architect reliable:

* Intelligence Foundations,
* Human in Command governance,
* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 2,800 employees across 28 countries, we help organisations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organisations.

**AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

title: Engineering Manager - Vice President
description:
Join us as an Engineering Manager - Vice President at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be a successful Engineering Manager - Vice President, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience: Hands-on experience in software engineering, with experience in a technical leadership role.
* Mobile Expertise: Experience with React Native, native iOS (Swift/Objective-C), and Android (Java/Kotlin).
* Web Expertise: Proficiency in React.js or similar frameworks (Angular, Vue.js).
* Technical Stack: Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
* Strong understanding of AI-native, agentic, and multi-agent architectures with appropriate governance controls.
* Engineering leadership across large-scale distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
* Proven experience driving reliability, resilience, automation, and SDLC optimization
* Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead teams, manage delivery, and foster collaboration.

**Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued**

* Experience in financial services or regulated environments.
* Strong Problem-solving skill and stake holder management.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.
* Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.
* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Staff Engineer, Quality Engineering [T500-30260]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About DIRECTV:**

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

**About DIRECTV India GCC:**

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. It’s a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world’s most dynamic talent markets.

**Our Purpose:**

We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Functional EVP:**

Engineer quality into every stage of delivery

Quality at DIRECTV starts long before a product reaches the customer. As part of DQE, you’ll work alongside engineering teams to strengthen how software is designed, tested and released. You’ll drive automation, testing and quality practices across products and platforms, helping teams identify issues earlier, improve reliability and deliver with greater confidence.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking an experienced and innovative Staff Engineer, Quality Engineering to serve as a senior technical leader within our Test Environment & Data Management organization. This role designs and advances scalable test environments, service virtualization solutions, automated provisioning capabilities, and AI-enabled testing infrastructure. Our Purpose
  
  
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Title and Summary
  
  
Senior Specialist, Product Experience Design
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for an experienced User Experience/Interaction Designer passionate about the possibilities of data and data-driven experience design with good knowledge and experience of User Interface Design to join our rapidly growing, highly-innovative data and services Product Development team at our development center in Pune.
  
  
The design function works as part of wider cross-functional teams that form organically around data product ideas – collectively contributing to the rapid iteration of Prototypes and MVPs (Minimal Viable Product), mainly in the B2B and B2B2C arenas. Each design iteration is exposed to end-users at each cycle of our rapid design-test-redesign process, to ensure optimum user traction. Prototype and MVP outputs include dashboards; widgets; chatbots; web applications; mobile applications; VUI voice interfaces; digital assistants; etc. – all in service of solving complex business challenges and with an ever increasing emphasis on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).
  
  
Role
  
  

* Design of Proof-of-Concepts and Minimum Viable Data Products (MVPs) using human-centric design principles and rapid prototyping (Lean UX and Design Thinking)
* Participate in "Design Thinking" workshops – collaborating cross-functionally with industry verticals, regional leads and end-users to ensure optimal digital data products
* Explore the “art-of-the-possible” in the era of Big Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) – whilst always maintaining regulatory compliance
* Leverage existing – and contribute net new – design patterns to Mastercard’s design pattern library
* Help define the next generation of data and data-driven products – and through doing so, help shape the future of Mastercard and its growth
* Creation of a cohesive and compelling visual language across diverse form factors: web, mobile and internet of things
* Work on future state conceptual designs, driving experimentation that improves the quality of product design overall.
* Work closely with key partners from brand & marketing, alongside the broader user experience team to drive delightful and highly usable transactional experiences leveraging the broader visual language for MasterCard.
* Work closely with our technology team to define implementation standard for our products leveraging modern presentation layer practices such as adaptive/responsive web and current and forward thinking technologies.
* Ensure that designs deliver an appropriate balance of optimizing business objectives & user engagement, in close partnership with product managers.
* Liaise with regional and country teams to ensure that designs are reflective of the diversity of needs for a global user base
* Drive VXD design across a broader ecosystem, where experiences will require tailoring to meet the needs of both MasterCard customers and end consumers
* Help define the next generation of data and data-driven products and their visualization – and through doing so, help shape the future of Mastercard and its growth

**All About You**
Required Experience / Knowledge / Skills (Core)
  
  
**Interaction Design**

* Experience developing User Archetypes and Personas and user journeys to inform product design decisions
* Experience in rapid prototyping (Lean UX and Design Thinking)
* Experience in articulating elegant and engaging experiences using sketches, storyboards, information architecture blueprints and prototypes
* Experience in the implementation of creative, useable and compelling visual mockups and prototypes.
* Experience working with complex information architectures
* Experience of design-experiences across multiple media
* Experience using prototyping/wireframing tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe Experience Design, Adobe Illustrator etc.
* An understanding of complex information architectures for digital applications

**Visual Design**
Additional Experience / Knowledge / Skills
  
  

* Experience in articulating elegant and engaging visual experiences using sketches, storyboards, and within prototypes
* Highly proficient in the creation of useable, compelling and elegant visual mockups and prototypes.
* Experience of visual design across multiple media and form factors: web; mobile; Internet-of-Things (IOT)
* Extensive and demonstrable experience using leading VXD software packages such as Adobe Creative Cloud / Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator etc.) / Experience Design, Serif DrawPlus, Corel DRAW Graphics Suite / PaintShopPro, Art Rage, Xara or equivalent
* An understanding of complex information architectures for visual representation
* Any experience in motion graphic design is a strong plus
* Any experience in 3D modeling also a strong plus

**Research**

* Experience consuming UX research
* Experience in leading “Design Thinking” workshops with customers to identify requirements and ideate on potential product solutions.
* Ability to identify best-in-class user experience through competitor analysis
* Experience of iterative “design-test-re-design” methodology to collect real user feedback to incorporate back into the design

Candidate
  
  

* Prior experience working in a world-beating UX team
* Experience working/multi-tasking in an extremely fast-paced startup-like environment
* Experience in client-facing engagements, preferably in leading them
* Empathetic champion of the user – passionate about the detail of great usability, interaction design and aesthetics to give the best possible UX
* Passionate about the possibility of data driven experiences – so-called “emergent ontologies” (patterns in the data) driving UX and UI. Passionate about the potential for data, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning ML)
* Defensible point-of-view on and Adaptive v Responsive v Liquid/Fluid UI
* Defensible point-of-view on gamification
* Interest in VUIs (Voice Interfaces)
* Demonstrable knowledge of UX and Interaction Design heuristics and best practices: e.g. Lean UX; Mobile First etc.
* Demonstrable knowledge of ergonomic and usability best practices
* Bachelors or Masters Degree in Design for Interactive Media, or equivalent experience
* World-beating portfolio covering multiple form-factors: desktop; tablet; mobile; wearable; other
* Demonstrable commitment to learning: insatiable to discover and evaluate new concepts and technologies to maximize design possibility.

Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Associate- Manual+Automation QA
description:
**Job Purpose**
Seeking a Manual & Automation QA Engineer with strong Capital Markets and Fixed Income expertise to drive functional, integration, end-to-end, and data quality testing across trading, post-trade, investment management, and data platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring application quality, data accuracy, business rule compliance, and regulatory adherence through manual testing, source-to-target validation, reconciliation, and automation-led regression testing. The ideal candidate will leverage Python/SQL-based automation frameworks, validate complex fixed-income and post-trade workflows, and collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to deliver high-quality, reliable solutions across legacy and modern technology environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform functional, system, integration, and end-to-end testing across fixed income applications
* Validate complete trade lifecycle events across asset classes including trade capture, order management, execution, confirmation, clearing, settlement, corporate actions, and reporting.
* Perform testing of derivative products and workflows including Options, Swaps, Futures, and Forwards.
* Validate business workflows covering bonds, treasuries, corporate debt, and other fixed income instruments
* Verify trade booking, valuations, cashflows, margin processing, lifecycle events, and settlement workflows across asset classes.
* Create, execute, and maintain comprehensive test cases, test scenarios, and regression test suites
* Perform requirement analysis and ensure test coverage aligned with business and regulatory requirements
* Collaborate with business analysts, traders, product owners, and development teams to validate business functionality
* Support testing across legacy platforms and modern cloud-based applications
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* Strong experience in Manual Testing methodologies and QA best practices
* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
* Strong experience in test case design, defect management, and regression testing
* Deep domain knowledge of Capital Markets with expertise in Fixed Income products and workflows
* Experience validating trade lifecycle processes including order management, execution, allocations, settlements, and reporting
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test case generation, requirement analysis, defect investigation, test documentation, and test data preparation
* Hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles.
* Good Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Good SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or similar tools
* Experience with market data, reference data, pricing, and security master validation
* Understanding of fixed income analytics including yields, durations, coupon calculations, and bond pricing

title: VP - Technical Lead - Equity Technology
description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Equities Technology**
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
  
  
Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Job Title: Technical Lead – Securities Finance Technology**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Team: Equities – Prime Services Securities Finance Technology**
**Level: Senior / Team Lead**
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Technical Team Lead to join our Securities Finance Technology team in Pune. This role will be responsible for leading the India-based development team and contributing to the design, development, and delivery of strategic trading and securities finance platforms used by a global user base.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in Java, Spring, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and enterprise application development, along with proven leadership experience in managing delivery teams. This individual will work closely with business stakeholders, technology partners, and global teams across New York, London, and Hong Kong to deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of developers across Java and C# technologies, ensuring high-quality engineering practices and timely delivery.
* Design, develop, and maintain core components of the Securities Finance technology platform.
* Drive the development of scalable distributed systems and enterprise-grade applications.
* Own end-to-end project delivery, including sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, testing coordination, release planning, and production rollouts.
* Collaborate closely with global technology teams and business stakeholders to align on priorities, requirements, and technical direction.
* Act as a key point of contact between the Pune team and global teams across New York, London, and Hong Kong.
* Translate business requirements into robust technical solutions while ensuring performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Promote engineering best practices including clean code, automation, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and delivery reviews.
* Support production stability by contributing to issue analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of systems.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 12 years of hands-on software development experience, primarily in Core Java and Spring / Spring Boot frameworks.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and managing end-to-end software delivery.
* Strong experience in designing and building distributed systems, microservices, and enterprise-grade applications.
* Solid understanding of SQL and relational database concepts.
* Experience with messaging, caching, and streaming technologies such as Kafka and Redis.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, and SNS.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies including Scrum and Kanban.
* Ability to lead Agile ceremonies and drive predictable, high-quality delivery.
* Experience with DevOps practices including:

+ CI/CD pipelines
+ Docker and Kubernetes
+ Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible
+ Source control and build tools such as Jira, Bitbucket, and Bamboo

* Familiarity with monitoring and logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global, cross-functional environment.
* Openness to adopting and promoting AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve engineering productivity.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience in financial services, capital markets, trading systems, or Securities Finance technology.
* Understanding of Securities Finance, stock borrow loan, collateral, trading workflows, or Prime Services platforms.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Exposure to C# or experience managing teams working across both Java and C# stacks.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

title: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist
description:
**Designation: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Job Summary**

Aventior is seeking a CSV & Software Validation Specialist with experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of regulatory compliance, quality management, computerized system validation (CSV), and software testing within regulated environments.

The role involves ensuring that software applications and computerized systems meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business specifications. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, validating system functionality, documenting test results, managing defects, and supporting compliance activities in accordance with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

The candidate will collaborate with Quality Assurance, Software Development, Clinical Operations, IT, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure software quality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the software development and validation lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GLP, based on project and system requirements.
* Support compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU and UK regulations for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and access controls.
* Apply GAMP 5 principles and risk-based approaches to computerized system validation and software testing.
* Review and maintain SOPs, work instructions, validation documents, and quality records.
* Support compliance assessments, internal and external audits, client audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.
* Assist with deviation management, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, and compliance remediation activities.
* Support data integrity, security, traceability, and documentation requirements for regulated systems.

**2. Software Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for software applications used in biopharma and life sciences.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Validate application workflows, data processing, user permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and system interfaces.
* Identify, document, track, and retest software defects in collaboration with development and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to establish traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and test results.
* Ensure testing activities are documented, reproducible, and aligned with approved procedures and validation protocols.
* Support test execution, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution verification.
* Participate in release testing, regression testing, and post-implementation verification.

**3. Computerized System Validation (CSV)**

* Support validation activities for GxP-regulated software applications and computerized systems.
* Prepare and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, validation plans, and test protocols.
* Execute or support Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ), where applicable.
* Assist with validation of new systems, system upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, and software releases.
* Ensure validation evidence is complete, accurate, approved, and audit-ready.
* Support periodic reviews, change impact assessments, and revalidation activities based on risk and regulatory requirements.
* Apply risk-based validation principles in accordance with GAMP 5 and organizational quality procedures.

**4. Biopharma & Life Sciences Application Testing**

* Test and validate applications supporting clinical trials, clinical data management, pharmaceutical quality processes, laboratory operations, and regulatory workflows.
* Understand regulated-system requirements relating to patient data, clinical trial records, laboratory data, and electronic documentation.
* Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, access controls, audit trails, and system-generated records.
* Support testing of integrations between clinical, laboratory, quality management, and other enterprise applications.
* Help ensure that software changes do not compromise patient safety, product quality, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
* Support HIPAA-related privacy and security requirements when applications handle protected health information (PHI).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in compliance, software testing, quality assurance, or computerized system validation within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or life sciences environments.
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations, including GMP, GCP, and GLP.
* Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, EU and UK regulations, and electronic records and electronic signature requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manual software testing, test case preparation, test execution, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Hands on experience with QMS platforms like ServiceNow, Veeva, Master Control a huge plus.
* Experience preparing or executing validation protocols and maintaining validation documentation, including URS, IQ, OQ, PQ, and RTMs, as applicable.
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and change management.
* Experience with CAPA, deviation management, change control, and audit documentation.
* Understanding of data integrity, audit trails, access controls, and security requirements in regulated systems.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing and compliance activities.

**Company Overview:**

**Aventior**

is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as
**artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps**

to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the life science industry.

Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including
**cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization,**

and
**automated data capture**

for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.

At Aventior, our strength lies in combining
**deep industry expertise**

with
**advanced technical capabilities**

. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making.

We bring a
**holistic, cross-industry perspective**

to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in
**design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support**

. With a
**global delivery model**

, a
**multi-country presence**

, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale.

* Execute configuration activities across templates, clauses, business rules, workflows, metadata, and related Icertis components.

title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
description:
**Job Purpose**
Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.
* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.
* Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.
* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
  
  

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.
* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.
* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.
  
  

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

We are looking for a hands-on Manager, Software Engineering to lead a software development team building modern, scalable systems at Hershey. This role is ideal for a manager who enjoys balancing people leadership with technical oversight, driving reliable delivery, and partnering closely with product and design.
  
  
As an Staff Software Development Engineer, you will be accountable for your team’s execution, quality, and growth. You’ll help engineers deliver high-quality software predictably, support their career development, and ensure strong engineering practices are consistently applied. You will work in a collaborative environment spanning multiple business domains such as supply chain, marketing, and consumer insights.

Drive Team Execution
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery of features and services by your team. You facilitate agile ceremonies, help prioritize work, manage technical debt trade-offs, and remove impediments that slow progress. You partner with engineers to maintain focus on outcomes while balancing speed, quality, and sustainability.
  
  
Develop Engineering Talent
  
  
You own the day-to-day people management responsibilities for individual contributors on your team. This includes regular 1:1s, actionable feedback, career development discussions, and performance reviews. You help engineers grow their technical and professional skills while aligning individual goals with team and organizational needs.
  
  
Partner with Product and Design
  
  
You collaborate closely with Product Managers and Designers to define scope, clarify requirements, and prioritize the backlog. You oversee code review and design review practices and help define what “good quality” looks like for the team. You advocate observability, reliability, and maintainability, so systems are ready to operate in production.
  
  
Recruit and Build the Team
  
  
You actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and retaining engineers. You contribute to building a balanced team with the skills needed to meet current and future goals.

title: Lead - Infrastructure Testing Governance & ServiceNow Test Management Product
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and strategic
**Infrastructure Testing Governance & ServiceNow Test Management Product Lead**
to drive the evolution of enterprise infrastructure testing practices and own the ServiceNow Test Management platform roadmap.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining and governing infrastructure testing processes, ensuring testing controls and quality gates are consistently applied across technology changes, and driving continuous improvement through incident analysis and lessons learned. The individual will serve as the Product Lead for the ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM), partnering with stakeholders and ServiceNow development teams to translate business requirements into scalable solutions that improve testing effectiveness, traceability, compliance, and operational resilience.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines expertise in testing governance, process design, requirements management, ServiceNow product ownership, and cross-functional leadership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
ServiceNow Test Management Product Ownership
  
  

* Own the vision, roadmap, and continuous enhancement of the ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM).
* Gather, document, and prioritize business requirements from testing, engineering, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements and user stories.
* Partner closely with ServiceNow developers, architects, and platform teams to design and implement solutions.
* Manage product backlog, feature prioritization, and release planning.
* Drive user adoption and ensure platform capabilities align with evolving organizational needs.
* Establish metrics and reporting to measure platform value and effectiveness.

Infrastructure Testing Governance
  
  

* Define, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure testing standards, processes, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure testing requirements, controls, and process gates are consistently applied across infrastructure changes.
* Drive adherence to testing policies, validation standards, and governance requirements.
* Establish testing readiness criteria and approval processes for infrastructure changes.
* Partner with change management, engineering, and operational teams to improve testing quality and change success rates.
* Monitor testing compliance and identify areas for process improvement.

Testing Process Leadership
  
  

* Lead the development and continuous improvement of testing methodologies, workflows, and operating procedures.
* Standardize testing practices across infrastructure and platform teams.
* Define testing requirements, traceability expectations, and quality metrics.
* Promote automation and efficient validation practices to increase testing coverage and reduce operational risk.
* Ensure testing processes support risk-based decision making and production stability objectives.

Incident Review and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Facilitate post-implementation reviews and incident analysis related to infrastructure changes.
* Identify testing gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions resulting from production incidents and testing failures.
* Leverage incident trends and metrics to enhance testing standards, controls, and platform capabilities.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, application teams, platform teams, quality engineering, risk, audit, and change management stakeholders.
* Lead governance discussions and provide recommendations to leadership on testing strategy and process improvements.
* Communicate testing risks, readiness, compliance status, and improvement opportunities to senior stakeholders.
* Influence adoption of enterprise testing standards and best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Management, Infrastructure Testing, Change Management, or related disciplines.
* Experience defining and governing enterprise testing processes and controls.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
* Experience partnering with development teams to deliver technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, testing methodologies, and change management practices.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving organizational change.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM) experience.
* ServiceNow Product Owner or Platform Owner experience.
* Experience with infrastructure change testing and validation.
* Knowledge of enterprise governance, risk, and compliance practices.
* Experience implementing process improvement programs.
* Familiarity with testing automation platforms and reporting solutions.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise technology environments.

Success in This Role
  
  
**A Successful Candidate Will**

* Establish a scalable and effective infrastructure testing governance framework.
* Drive adoption and maturity of the ServiceNow Test Management platform.
* Improve testing compliance, traceability, and operational consistency.
* Reduce production risk through stronger testing controls and processes.
* Use incident learnings to continuously improve testing effectiveness.
* Serve as the trusted leader for enterprise testing governance and ServiceNow test management capabilities.

This description should attract candidates who can function as a
**Product Owner, Business Analyst, Process Owner, Governance Lead, and Testing Strategist**
all within a single role. That's likely the profile you need given the breadth of ownership you're describing.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
