title: Senior Software Consultant - QA
description:
**Department:**
Development

**Location:**
Pune, India

**Description**
ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
  
  
Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and - through our product SIMS - collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.
  
  
ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.
  
  
Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced
**Senior QA Engineer**
to join our Agile product development team. The ideal candidate will ensure high-quality software delivery through strong manual testing, automation, API validation, and end-to-end testing practices.
  
  
This role requires a balance of
**hands-on manual testing expertise and automation capabilities**
, along with strong collaboration across cross-functional teams. You will play a key role in identifying quality risks early and driving continuous improvements in testing processes.
  
  

* Understand business and technical requirements and convert them into detailed test scenarios and test cases.
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web, mobile, and API-based applications.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Validate end-to-end workflows across UI, API, and database layers.
* Conduct UI testing to ensure functionality, usability, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Perform API testing using tools like Postman or Swagger (validate requests, responses, status codes, and data integrity).
* Execute database testing using SQL queries to validate data accuracy and backend processing.
* Identify, log, track, and verify defects using tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Collaborate closely with Developers, Product Owners, and Business teams to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Participate in test planning, execution, reporting, and release sign-off activities.
* Support UAT activities and coordinate with stakeholders for validation and issue resolution.
* Develop and maintain automation frameworks and test scripts (UI/API).
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Analyze test results and communicate quality metrics to stakeholders.
* Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA process improvements.
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Standups, Reviews, and Retrospectives.

Key Competencies:
  
  

* Strong attention to detail with a quality-first mindset
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership
* Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams
* Mentoring and leadership capabilities
* Continuous learning and adaptability

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
Required Skills and Experience:
  
  

* 7–8 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing.
* Strong expertise in Manual Testing methodologies and processes.
* Hands-on experience in:
* API Testing (Postman, Swagger, REST APIs)
* UI/Web Testing
* SQL/Database Testing (complex queries, joins, validations)
* Experience in test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of BDD/TDD tools like Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Gherkin.
* Experience in building and maintaining test automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
* Experience working with microservices and backend systems.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar tools.
* Experience in defect tracking, test management, and reporting.
* Experience in cross-browser and cross-platform testing.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with cloud platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure).
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, or k6.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience in containerized environments.
* Relevant certifications such as ISTQB or Agile Testing certifications

Agile Methodology:

* Strong experience working in Agile development environments.
* Hands-on exposure to Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and XP methodologies.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, and continuously evolving environment.

description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Requirements Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Associate**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
The Requirements Engineer will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and software development teams for credit and debit card processing applications. The role is responsible for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business and system requirements throughout the product delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with product owners, operations, compliance, risk, customer service, and technology stakeholders to understand business needs.
* Act as the go-between for business and development teams, translating business objectives into clear functional and non-functional requirements.
* Elicit requirements through workshops, interviews, process reviews, data analysis, and stakeholder discussions.
* Create and maintain business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, use cases, interface requirements, and traceability records.
* Support applications covering card authorization, clearing and settlement, transaction processing, refunds, reversals, disputes, chargebacks, fees, and reconciliation.
* Analyze impacts across upstream and downstream systems, integrations, APIs, data flows, and operational processes.
* Work with architects, developers, and testers to clarify requirements and resolve gaps, conflicts, and dependencies.
* Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and daily Scrum activities.
* Assist quality assurance teams with test scenarios, requirement coverage, defect triage, and business acceptance testing.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, track decisions and changes, and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure requirements consider security, privacy, regulatory, audit, resilience, and card-industry controls.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Experience as a Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role in financial services or payments technology.
* Working knowledge of credit and debit card transaction lifecycles and card processing platforms.
* Strong requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, modelling, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences and convert complex needs into actionable requirements.
* Practical experience working in Agile Scrum teams and understanding Scrum roles, ceremonies, artefacts, and backlog management.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence or equivalent requirements and delivery-management platforms.
* Experience writing well-structured user stories and testable acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams.
* Familiar with Agile Team management tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Pro-active team player with good communication skills as well as good English language skills.
* Experience with Agile/SCRUM environment including agile tooling and methodology together with knowledge of cards.
* Bachelor's degree from a college or university with an focus on IT or data evaluation and / or comparable professional experience

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

description:

**technology team**

Leads cross-functional teams to provide agile-based project deliverables and facilitates the team's work to accelerate delivery of business value by ensuring adherence to Scrum methodologies and processes. Facilitates internal and external communication, removes impediments, and serves as the intermediary between multiple product owners, managers, and team members. This role will own QA release sign-off, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, drive release regression, and continuously improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing. Exposure to Web, API, and Microservices testing will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate will help accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

• Accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

• Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.

• Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.

title: Sr Mgr Software Engineering
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
  
As a Sr Mgr Software Engineering in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
  
Role Summary
  
We are seeking a Sr Mgr Software Engineering to lead a cross-functional team (Software Engineering, DevOps/Platform, Support and Quality Engineering) building and operating a low-latency, high-throughput core banking product platform. You will be accountable for end-to-end delivery: architecture-to-production execution, operational excellence, reliability, security/compliance, and an automation-first quality strategy. You will also bring demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled initiatives and implementing AI-based solutions in production.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1) Engineering Leadership & Delivery
  
- Lead and grow a cross-functional team spanning backend, frontend, DevOps/Platform engineering, and Quality Engineering; drive strong ownership, execution discipline, and continuous improvement.
  
- Own delivery for roadmap initiatives and platform modernization across the full SDLC: planning, design, implementation, reviews, testing, release, and production operations.
  
- Establish and communicate technical direction in partnership with Product Management and Architecture to ensure the platform meets business goals and non-functional requirements.
  
2) Low-Latency, Reliability, and Performance (NFR-First)
  
- Drive performance and latency engineering: define latency/throughput SLOs, performance budgets, regression testing, and capacity planning to maintain predictable low-latency behavior under load.
  
- Build “always-on” operational readiness: observability (logs/metrics/traces), runbooks, safe rollouts (feature flags, progressive delivery), and rapid rollback practices.
  
- Partner with Platform/SRE functions to ensure Kubernetes runtime reliability patterns (HA, scaling, and operational tooling) are built into the product delivery lifecycle. ,
  
3) DevOps / Platform Engineering Ownership
  
- Lead the team’s cloud-native delivery model on Kubernetes (including GitOps-based deployment and configuration-as-code). ,
  
- Own and evolve CI/CD and artifact practices using technologies such as Ansible, Nexus, Carvel toolchain (e.g., ytt, kapp-controller), and Kubernetes-native release workflows.
  
- Ensure secure, repeatable environment provisioning and reliable deployments across dev/test/stage/prod with automation as the default.
  
4) Quality Engineering & Test Automation (Shift-Left)
  
- Build a “quality-first” culture with an automated testing strategy across unit/integration/e2e, with strong coverage targets and non-negotiable quality gates.
  
- Implement and operationalize modern test orchestration and automation tooling, including Testkube, and enforce reliable, maintainable CI test execution.
  
- Drive security and compliance testing as part of CI/CD (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning), ensuring regulated-workload readiness and auditability. ,
  
5) AI-Enabled Engineering & Delivered AI Projects (Must-Have)
  
- Lead delivery of AI-enabled initiatives in two dimensions: 1. AI-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation, documentation, defect reduction), and
  
2. AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or operational capability. ,
  
  
- Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and maintainability before merging.
  
- Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions.
  
6) People Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
- Coach engineers, DevOps, and QE leads; build career plans, performance feedback loops, and hiring strategies to raise the talent bar.
  
- Collaborate with Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations leaders to deliver outcomes with transparency, predictable execution, and clear metrics.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
- 15+ years in software engineering building distributed systems; 5+ years leading teams (engineering + DevOps and/or QE leadership experience strongly preferred).
  
- Proven experience building and operating low-latency, high-throughput systems in banking, payments, or other regulated transaction platforms.
  
- Hands-on expertise with: - Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures (microservices, containerization, orchestration)
  
- Java backend development (high-performance, concurrent, resilient services)
  
- Angular (modern web UI, performance-minded frontend engineering)
  
- Ansible (automation/configuration management)
  
- Nexus (artifact repository and dependency management)
  
- Cloud Infrastructure ( Familiarity with deployment and development on public and private cloud Azure , AWS, OpenShift)
  
- Carvel toolchain (e.g., ytt, kapp-controller) for packaging/config/deploy workflows
  
- Testkube for test orchestration and automation
  
  
- Demonstrated delivery of AI projects implemented in real environments (production or production-like), such as: - GenAI-assisted developer workflows with measurable outcomes (quality/velocity/defect reduction), and/or
  
- AI/ML capabilities embedded into product or operations (e.g., automated diagnostics, anomaly detection, intelligent triage, or similar).
  
  
- Strong engineering excellence mindset: automated testing, security-by-design, observability, and disciplined release practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- Experience with GitOps and Kubernetes platform components (policy-as-code, secrets management, progressive delivery). ,
  
- Experience with regulated environments and compliance constraints (PCI/GDPR/SOC2) and integrating security controls into CI/CD. ,
  
- Experience scaling test automation and implementing testing pyramids and coverage standards across multiple teams.
  
- Familiarity with internal developer platform concepts (“golden paths”, self-service, reduced cognitive load).
  
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level: Manager**
Build and lead engineering teams that deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality technology solutions aligned to cyber transformation objectives. As an Engineering Manager II, you will drive execution across the software development lifecycle, partner with cross-functional stakeholders, and help modernize engineering practices to support client and business needs. This role requires strong delivery management, technical oversight, and the ability to guide teams through complex implementation work.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Engineering Manager II on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Leading engineering teams in the design, build, testing, deployment, and support of technology solutions
* Managing project delivery plans, team priorities, and execution timelines across multiple workstreams
* Partnering with product, architecture, cyber, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
* Establishing engineering standards, delivery controls, and quality practices across the development lifecycle
* Coaching engineers and technical leads to improve delivery consistency, issue resolution, and team performance

**The Team**
Cyber Strategy & Transformation teams develop and transform cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. They keep the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and give stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Services include the design of cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments. Services also encompass Cybersecurity Assessments and Frameworks, Cyber Transformation Management, Technology Software and Asset Compliance Management, Third Party Risk Management, Cyber Risk and Compliance, Solution Design and Implementation, and Cyber Risk Analytics and Quantification Reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or cyber technology delivery
* 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical leads, or delivery workstreams
* Experience managing application development, system integration, or platform implementation programs
* Experience with Agile delivery, sprint planning, backlog management, and release coordination
* Experience working with cloud platforms, application architecture, and secure development practices

Preferred:
  
  

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or Cybersecurity
* Experience supporting cyber transformation, risk, compliance, or security technology programs
* Experience with DevSecOps, continuous integration, and continuous deployment practices
* Experience with engineering governance, metrics reporting, and delivery quality controls
* Experience working with enterprise stakeholders across product, architecture, operations, and risk teams
* Industry certifications in cloud, cybersecurity, Agile, or program delivery

description:
**Company Description**

**Arista Networks**
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

**Who You’ll Work With**

Arista Networks is seeking high-caliber self-motivated test engineers for its enterprise and cloud-managed WiFi products. This role will involve testing and validating complex cloud infrastructure and services that power WiFi networks, ensuring they perform at scale and meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and efficiency. You will play a key role in the design, development, and execution of comprehensive test plans for cloud-based Wi-Fi solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading products.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the testing efforts on the cloud infrastructure that supports Wi-Fi networks, ensuring scalability, performance, and resilience in different environments (Cloud and On-premise deployments)
* Design and execute performance, scalability, and load tests to ensure the cloud services can handle heavy traffic and provide reliable WiFi services under various conditions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to conduct integration tests for cloud-based services that interface with hardware. Ensure seamless interactions between cloud APIs and the Access Points.
* Create solution based detailed test plans, test cases, and test reports for all stages of the development lifecycle. Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects.
* “Own” the feature and core area of the product, and be the single point of contact and testing expert for your deliverables.
* Track defects and issues using defect management systems, ensuring they are escalated appropriately and resolved in a timely manner.
* Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, provide feedback, and ensure high-quality product delivery.
* Participate in escalations debugging and reproduce the complex issues reported by customers.
* Mentor junior team members and share best practices in testing and cloud-based WiFi solution validation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in E&TC/EE/CE/CS/IT or a related field; Master’s degree a plus.
* 10 - 15 years of experience in testing & troubleshooting Cloud technologies, virtualization, Microservices, and debugging complex software
* Good experience in working with Hadoop & Big data technologies like HDFS, HBase, Spark, Kafka streaming, and Elasticsearch
* Good working knowledge of Database (SQL) and Server side validations.
* Experience with various performance testing methods (Load test, Stress test, and capacity test) will be a plus.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals around scalability, elasticity, availability, and fault tolerance.
* Experience in Networking Tools and networking fundamentals across the OSI stack is a plus.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills and proven expertise in creating test methodologies and writing test plans.
* Strong knowledge of Linux systems.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python will be a plus.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Adaptive to learning new things and technologies

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.
  
  
**How We Work**

* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

* Drive continual improvement of operational processes and user experience.
* Partner with operations teams to improve service reliability, scalability, and efficiency.

+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
+ Authentication Modernization
+ Authorization Modernization
+ Role Based Access Control (RBAC)
+ Fine-Grained Authorization
+ Machine Identity Governance
+ Agent and AI Identity Governance
+ SaaS Security Integration
+ Identity Intelligence & Risk Analytics

* Support audits, examinations, and control reviews.
* Partner with Risk, Audit, Architecture, and Security organizations to define and maintain control requirements.
* Translate regulatory requirements into roadmap priorities and product capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for delivery of risk-reducing capabilities and control improvements.

* IAM Strategy & Roadmaps
* Identity Governance Platforms
* Privileged Access Platforms
* Authentication & Authorization Products
* IAM Automation & Workflow Orchestration
* RBAC & Access Governance
* Identity Analytics & Reporting
* Machine Identity Governance
* AI & Agent Identity Governance
* IAM Metrics, KPIs, KCIs & KRIs

* Strong understanding of IAM disciplines including:

+ Authentication
+ Authorization
+ Identity Governance
+ Access Lifecycle Management
+ RBAC
+ OAuth/OIDC
+ SAML
+ MFA
+ PAM
+ Machine Identities

* Experience with automation and workflow platforms.

**Success Measures**

* Improved control effectiveness and regulatory readiness.

title: Senior PMT
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior PMT
  
  
Senior Product Manager-Technical
  
  
**Overview**
==================
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.
  
  
Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.
  
  
Under BMI, Payment Reconciliation Intelligence (PRI) Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the generative AI use cases, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
====================================
  
  
Own strategy and roadmap for Gen AI and agentic capabilities across Payment Reconciliation Intelligence.
  
  
Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value
  
  
Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products.
  
  
Partner closely with engineering, data science/AI, other platform/COE teams to ensure architecture quality, safety, evaluation, and observability.
  
  
Own PRDs, backlog prioritizations, story writing, dependencies, and release planning.
  
  
Partner with Customer Experience team to design intuitive, highly relevant features that are of maximum value to clients.
  
  
Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives
  
  
Lead user research, discovery, and experimentation to validate use cases, accuracy, trust, and business impact.
  
  
Support go-to-market, and customer enablement through demos, query resolution, documentation, and training.
  
  
Build strong cross-functional and stakeholder alignment across global teams.
  
  
Mentor and develop junior product managers.
  
  
**Qualifications / Desired Experiences**
====================================
  
  
Product management and end to end delivery of products.
  
  
Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements.
  
  
Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features.
  
  
Designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer.
  
  
Excellent execution, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  
  
Good to have : AI know how, specifically experience of working on Gen AI & agentic use cases support & delivery
  
  
Payments industry experience is a plus
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Application Development Lead (ADL) is responsible for overseeing delivery of high-profile software development initiatives under the defined jurisdiction. This includes Salesforce teams, corporate technology support teams, and vendor resources that contribute to business-critical projects and significant technical initiatives.

title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description: Roles & Responsibilities We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone. You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on. What Your Work Looks Like- You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution: Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct. Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against. Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do. What Makes Someone Right for This- 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them RequirementsIdeal Candidate Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics) Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement. Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities. Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation. Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements. Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights. Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation. Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days BenefitsOur people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role:**
You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence & Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership & loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
  
  
The Engineering Manager is accountable for engineering delivery, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and engineering team development. Partnering with Product Owners, Data Engineering & Analytics, Tech Leads, and peer engineering teams, you will enable predictable delivery, grow engineering talent, and build a high-performing culture focused on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Lead and develop a team of software engineers building product discovery experiences, including search, browse, merchandising, recommendations and consumer engagement capabilities.
* Enable the delivery of scalable, reliable and reusable services that power product discovery, content discovery and consumer engagement experiences across digital channels.

* Drive planning and execution against team objectives and key results (OKRs), ensuring alignment, accountability and transparent reporting.
* Own sprint execution, delivery planning, capacity management, dependency management, and risk management.
* Drive engineering excellence through strong development practices, quality standards, operational discipline and continuous improvement.
* Coach engineers through regular feedback, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
* Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and learning.
* Establish effective engineering metrics and use data to improve team productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI across software development, testing, documentation, knowledge management and onboarding.
* Collaborate with engineering leadership on hiring, staffing, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
* Manage delivery partners and vendors where applicable and ensure alignment with team objectives.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading engineering teams in an agile delivery environment.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience.
* Strong experience leading roadmap execution, delivery planning, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong people leadership skills with experience in hiring, mentoring, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including software architecture & engineering principles, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development.
* Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, and organisational leadership skills.
* Experience driving engineering quality, operational excellence, reliability, security, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira & Confluence or equivalent.
* A data-driven mindset with the ability to use engineering, delivery, and operational metrics to improve team effectiveness and predictability.
* Experience working with search, browse, recommendations, merchandising and product discovery capabilities.
* Experience working with consumer behavioural data, experimentation platforms, product catalogues, search technologies, recommendation engines, or personalization platforms will be a plus.
* Experience leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and team productivity will be a strong advantage.
* Experience in global DTC, retail, omnichannel commerce or high-volume consumer digital environment preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

**Position Overview**
**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**

* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.

* Best in class leave policy.

* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end-to-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

**Advantageous / Nice to Have**

* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across systems, applications, services, environments, and networks.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

title: Engineering Manager – Platform Engineering
description:

The Engineering Manager will lead the India engineering team building PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform. This is a hands-on role: you will balance day-to-day delivery and people management with real technical involvement — reviewing designs and code, and unblocking engineers — while working closely with the Lead Architect / Product Owner to turn technical designs and JIRA backlogs into shipped, quality-tested increments. You will also grow a high-performing engineering team.

* Lead and grow a team of engineers delivering PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform

* Stay hands-on — review designs, participate in architecture discussions, read and review code, and unblock engineers on FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, and RKE2/OpenShift deployment issues
* Translate technical design documents and JIRA stories into clear, sequenced execution plans for the India engineering team
* Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers; run performance conversations, set growth plans, and build a strong engineering culture within the team
* Coordinate closely with the external development vendor and internal architecture leadership to align delivery timelines, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain quality standards
* Drive engineering best practices: code review discipline, CI/CD hygiene, test coverage, and consistent frontend routing and coding standards across the team
* Partner with QA to plan release readiness, support UAT cycles, and ensure milestone sign-off criteria are met before delivery
* Manage risk and dependency tracking across concurrent workstreams (Model Deployment, Observability & Metrics, Secrets Management, GPU Quota/Billing) and escalate blockers early
* Contribute to technical decision-making on multi-tenant isolation, GPU resource quota enforcement, and identity/SSO federation as the platform evolves
* Report on team velocity, delivery risk, and capacity to the Lead Architect / Product Owner and other stakeholders

**Basic Qualifications**

* Education: B.E / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline
* Experience: 10-15 years in software engineering, with at least 2-3 years in a engineering manager/ tech-lead capacity leading a team of 5-10 engineers
* Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in at least one backend stack (Python/FastAPI or equivalent) and one frontend stack (React or equivalent), with the ability to review code and unblock engineers directly
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes-native application development and deployment (RKE2, OpenShift, or vanilla K8s)
* Experience managing delivery for complex, multi-service platforms (preferably virtualisation and control planes)
* Well versed with Agile methodology including sprint planning, estimation, prioritisation, governance and reporting
* Proven experience hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, including performance management
* Comfort working across India/US team structures and coordinating with external delivery vendors or partners
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical design detail and delivery status for architecture and product stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GPU-based infrastructure management and control platform, AI/ML inference platforms, or LLM serving stacks will be an solid added advantage
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, RBAC models, and quota/billing systems will be an added advantage
* Experience with PostgreSQL schema-per-service architectures and event-driven or workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n) will be an added advantage
* Exposure to Prometheus/Grafana-based observability stacks will be an added advantage
* Prior experience managing or coordinating with offshore/nearshore development vendors will be an added advantage
* Certifications such as CKA/CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes credentials are a plus

**Why Gruve**
At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Development Team Manager to lead our Active Integration R&D team in Pune. Your mission is to build and manage a high-performing team of engineers—including UI/UX & AI experts, Cloud Lead Developers, and Teamcenter specialists—to deliver the next generation of Siemens Xcelerator solutions.
  
  
The Active Integration platform features smart and ready to use gateways for SAP Business Suite, Oracle EBS, Opcenter, Product Cost Management and other Enterprise Applications.
  
  
As the Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a highly multi-functional, agile team comprising both local and external/contractor developers. In this role, you will act as a key bridge, collaborating closely with Product Management and the Software Operations team to orchestrate seamless software delivery. You will cultivate a collaborative culture that balances operational excellence with rapid innovation, ensuring our engineering efforts align directly with business and product objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management & Leadership: Partner closely with the Software Engineering Manager to supervise, hire, train, appraise, reward, motivate, and discipline engineering staff, including recommending termination when necessary.
* Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Act as the technical lead and mentor for junior engineers, offering high-level technical expertise, problem resolution, and leadership to the development group.
* System Design & Architecture: Create, document, and implement robust software designs, which includes spearheading the significant re-architecting of critical internal systems.
* Drive the adoption of AI-based development approaches within the team, ensuring AI is used as a core competency to accelerate engineering productivity.
* Functional Quality Assurance: Be responsible for and ensure the overall functional quality of all released software products, focusing on high-quality, on-time delivery that exceeds customer expectations.
* Product Direction & Innovation: Influence the technical roadmap for a specific product area and actively promote innovation by introducing new technologies and advanced knowledge to the team and product.
* Complex Programming & Analysis: Perform in-depth, highly complex software systems programming and analysis, working independently with complete latitude for judgment on advanced projects.
* Customer Collaboration & Advisory: Regularly collaborate with customers regarding future product upgrades, using a broad knowledge of internal operating systems, application implications, and customer environments.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the development process, driving permanent corrective actions and operational efficiency.

* Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.
* Experience:

+ 15+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management, leading R&D teams, or directing technical organizations.
+ 8+ years of Hands-on experience in C++/Full Stack/Cloud/AI Technologies
+ Demonstrated professional experience with Teamcenter is required.
+ Proven experience scaling enterprise-level software ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale digital transformation environments.
+ Enterprise Data & Migration Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on or leadership experience architecting and delivering large-scale data migration initiatives, enterprise data integration pipelines, and modern data lake / data warehouse architectures across heterogeneous systems (e.g., migrating legacy ERP/PLM data stores to cloud data platforms).

* Demonstrated success managing and orchestrating multi-functional, cross-cultural teams across international time zones (e.g., Europe and India).
* AI, Data Lakes & Analytics Mastery:

+ Strong conceptual and practical understanding of AI/ML ecosystems (LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and AI tooling).
+ Deep proficiency in enterprise data management, including structuring and querying data lakes, managing massive data migration projects, and establishing reliable ETL/ELT pipelines.

* Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization/orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) crucial for modern AIG infrastructure.
* Extensive experience with complex system integrations (Siemens Active Integration, SAP, PLM/ERP systems, event-driven architectures, and API gateways).
* Mastery of Agile methodologies, software lifecycle (SLC) governance, quality assurance, and fostering developer productivity through modern AI-assisted coding tools.
* Exceptional communication skills; ability to align executive leadership, product management, and hands-on engineering teams around a unified AI-first vision.

**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

**Vice President, Product Designer**

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
We are seeking a Senior Product Designer with experience working with, defining, and designing complex systems to bring creativity, strategic insight, and user-centered thinking to our team. This role requires an individual who excels in collaboration, design execution, and the ability to drive impactful user experiences.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Expertise**
**Craft**

* User-Centered Design – Lead with a user-first approach, ensuring all design choices address user needs, behaviors, and insights from research. Drive a seamless and intuitive product experience by deeply understanding our users.
* Journey Mapping – Map and analyze end-to-end user journeys across customers, operations, servicing teams and systems to identify pain points, key moments, and opportunities for improvement. Use journey maps to align teams on a shared vision of user needs, ensuring a cohesive and supportive experience at each stage.
* Interaction and UI Design – Demonstrates mastery in designing complex web interfaces and workflows, creating products that are both highly functional and visually engaging. Skilled in developing intuitive layouts, navigation patterns, and interaction models for intricate systems. Thoughtfully uses animation and micro-interactions to guide users, making complex tasks more approachable and enhancing the overall product experience.
* Proficiency in Design Tools – Possess advanced skills in tools such as Figma and Miro, to create high-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, and mockups that clearly communicate interaction models and UI specifications.

**Systems thinking**
  
  

* Design System Knowledge – Experience with and contribute to a global design system that ensures visual consistency across interfaces. Develop workflow patterns and components that can then be reused by other teams.
* Complex Systems Knowledge – Bring an understanding of the unique challenges of designing and maintaining complex systems, with an ability to distill intricate requirements into clear design solutions that facilitate user understanding and interaction.

**Collaboration and Communication**
  
  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to align design efforts with business goals, transforming complex requirements into clear, functional design solutions that respect technical constraints.

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Business Title: Engineering Manager**
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model,
**2-3 days in the office**
. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.
  
Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
  
  
**About the Role**
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and empower a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for owning the technical development of SailPoint’s core product capabilities. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, write and review quality code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous delivery. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with US-based teams and stakeholders to build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven microservices on AWS.
  
  
**About the Team**
At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. We are a results-driven crew built on innovation, collaboration, and mutual trust. Our team designs and deploys scalable, enterprise-grade identity security products powered by mature cloud architecture and cutting-edge technologies.
  
  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* **15+ years of experience in software engineering**
  , with demonstrated experience building, leading, and managing teams of software engineers
* Strong foundational understanding of
  **software development, particularly in Java,**
  as well as modern front-end architectures.
* Proven track record of success delivering complex software solutions in an Agile development environment
* Solid foundation in software engineering principles, distributed systems, and cloud architecture (AWS preferred)
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a passion for continuous improvement
* Strong project management abilities with experience scoping, prioritizing, tracking, and delivering engineering milestones
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones
* Willingness to maintain at least 4 overlapping working hours with US time zones

**AI-assisted engineering:**
Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.
  
  
**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code
* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy
* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
* LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

**Roadmap for Success**

**30 Days:**

* Complete SailPoint onboarding, understand our identity security product suite, and get familiar with the cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted on AWS.
* Establish relationships with your engineering team, Product Management partners, and US-based counterparts.
* Understand the current sprint commitments, team workflows, and active technical priorities.

**60 Days:**

* Assume day-to-day leadership of the engineering team and run Agile ceremonies effectively.
* Actively partner with Product Management to review roadmaps, scope incoming projects, and allocate engineering resources.
* Begin coaching and setting clear performance objectives for direct reports through regular 1:1 mentorship sessions.

**90 Days:**

* Own end-to-end project planning, tracking, and risk management for your team's deliverables and key milestones.
* Maintain a seamless communication cadence with global stakeholders, ensuring overlapping collaboration with the US team.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process or architectural improvements to raise code quality and team velocity.

**6 Months:**

* Drive the successful release of high-impact features and architectural enhancements to production on AWS.
* Foster a strong culture of career development, mentoring engineers toward their next career milestones.
* Proactively manage technical risk, system reliability, and resource allocation across multiple simultaneous initiatives.

**1 Year:**

* Establish a proven track record of predictable, high-quality product delivery that advances SailPoint’s identity security platform.
* Scale team capabilities, mentor emerging leaders, and contribute strategic engineering input toward long-term product roadmaps.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits**
:
  
Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:
