title: Senior QA Test Engineer GCC
description:
****Who is Litmus****
Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
  
  
AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
  
  
We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
  
  
Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
  
  
****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
  
  
****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.
  
  
****Have real impact, fast****
You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
  
  
****Join a high-performance team****
We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
  
  
****Our culture****
At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
  
  
We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring Senior QA Automation Engineers to test our data cataloging and real-time data platform products. You will build reliable automation with Playwright, turn business and technical requirements into test cases, and work with developers and product owners to improve product quality.
  
  
We have openings in two areas: application and API automation for our data cataloging product, and end-to-end data validation for our real-time data platform. Your experience will help us identify the best fit. Both openings are hands-on automation roles.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain automated UI tests with Playwright, using TypeScript or JavaScript, and build supporting test scripts and tools in Python where appropriate.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear test cases and automated coverage.
* Investigate test failures, work with developers to identify root causes, and improve test coverage and automation efficiency.
* Use Linux, Git and AI tools as part of your testing and automation work.

Depending on your product assignment, you will also:
  
  

* Automate API tests, build and troubleshoot Docker test environments, and set up and maintain CI pipelines for application testing.
* Test data flows from source systems to downstream destinations, checking completeness, correctness and consistency, and build scripts to generate test data and validate results at scale.

**What You Will Bring**

* QA experience with a strong focus on hands-on test automation.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated tests with Playwright.
* Automation coding skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills for the application automation opening.
* Confidence working in the Linux command line, using Git, and turning requirements into effective test cases.
* Experience using AI tools to support testing and test automation.

**Additional Requirements By Opening**

* Application and API automation: API testing experience; hands-on Docker skills, including building images, running containers and debugging; and experience with CI/CD practices and setting up pipelines in Jenkins, Git-based tooling or similar.
* Real-time data testing: 3–6 years of QA experience, including hands-on validation of data from source to destination; working knowledge of SQL and JSON; and the ability to automate data checks using Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. Docker and Kubernetes can be learned on the job.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data processing or cataloging products, industrial or IoT data, or MQTT, Kafka and other pub/sub messaging systems.
* Kubernetes, performance or load testing, and CI pipeline setup experience for the real-time data opening.

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.
  
  
We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent

**What makes you stand out:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

CSE SRE – DBA Focus

**Job Description**

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
* Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.

* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
* 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
* 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.
* 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required.
* Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale.
* Experience managing other database systems — PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc .
* CS Degree or equivalent experience.

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
* Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues.
* Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments.
* Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure.
* Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
* Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
* Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language.
* Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
* Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes.
* Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent).
* Experience with incident management platforms and on-call tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others.

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance***

* **Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently**
  through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar.
* **Detect drift early:**
  identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead.
* **Track portfolio health**
  through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders.

***Technical Assurance***

* **Assess solution architecture and engineering practice**
  for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability.
* **Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints**
  (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence.
* **Review operational risk:**
  hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live.

***Best-Practice Translation & Enablement***

* **Identify what works**
  in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions.
* **Spread learning across teams**
  by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery.
* **Help teams solve operational problems**
  as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio.

***Stakeholder & Team Leadership***

* **Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads**
  to align roadmap, technical feasibility and delivery priorities, and to surface cross-solution dependencies and shared-platform needs.
* **Guide and mentor the solution delivery leads and architects**
  across the portfolio; set expectations on delivery discipline and engineering quality, and give feedback on their performance.
* **Escalate clearly:**
  raise risks and decisions with options and recommendations to program governance and senior leadership.

**Qualifications**

***Must have***

* BE/B.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MBA / PG is a plus.
* 12+ years in IT services, product engineering or platform delivery, with a progression through developer, architect and delivery roles; has led or overseen more than one solution or team at a time.
* Strong technical grounding, enough to challenge architecture, code quality and engineering practice credibly: APIs and microservices, data pipelines, CI/CD, containers, observability and security.
* Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler's cloud and AI services and how they integrate with enterprise systems.
* Working knowledge of GenAI / Agentic AI solutions in production: LLM integration, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, LLMOps.
* Experience running review and governance mechanisms (design reviews, stage gates, release-readiness checks) across several concurrent programs.
* Proven ability to codify and transfer best practices across teams, such as playbooks, standards and reference architectures.

***Good to have***

* Experience in a product-company or product-engineering environment, working with product managers on roadmaps and releases.
* Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, model-evaluation tooling and agent interoperability standards (e.g. MCP).
* Hyperscaler AI certification(s) and/or PMP / Scrum / SAFe certification.
* Exposure to responsible-AI, data privacy and compliance requirements for enterprise AI.

**Expected Impact**

* Solutions across the IAIS portfolio are built as per roadmap, with early detection of drift and fewer late surprises.
* Consistent engineering quality and release readiness across solutions, rather than strong in some and weak in others.
* Best practices and lessons learned travel quickly between solutions, reducing rework and raising team capability.
* Delivery teams resolve operational and technical problems faster because proven fixes and experts are readily available.
* Stakeholders have a single, credible, KPI-driven view of portfolio delivery health.

**Skills**

Solution Portfolio Review, Roadmap Conformance Tracking, Technical Assurance, GenAI / Agentic AI Architecture Understanding, Hyperscaler / Cloud Integration, Best-Practice Codification, Delivery Governance, Technical Problem Solving, Coaching & Mentoring, Product-Engineering Partnership, Risk/Issue Management, KPI & Metrics Reporting, Stakeholder Management

title: Technical Scrum Master
description:
**Description**
**Leidos**
is seeking an experienced
**Technical Scrum Master**
to join the
**Air Traffic Business**
to support the design, development, integration and delivery of modern software solutions at the integration center in
**Pune, India.**
This role is ideal for a well-rounded software developer who brings strong traditional software engineering fundamentals along with experience or interest in developing and integrating AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
As a member of a Scaled Agile software development organization, you will contribute to the technical execution of a program that integrates proven, globally deployed technologies with modern cloud-native capabilities. You will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to deliver predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment.
  
  
In this position, you will serve as a
**DevSecOps Scrum Master,**
guiding Agile/SAFe processes while actively contributing to the design, development, and implementation of software solutions. You will foster effective collaboration across cross-functional teams and partner closely with the Product Owner, Systems Engineers, and development teams to align priorities and drive successful delivery. This role requires strong technical expertise, hands-on coding experience, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of a team, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining source code within an Agile environment.
* Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, product owners, and other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into working software.
* Work within Agile/Scrum development environments and participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.
* Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and services.
* Develop software using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, C#, or similar technologies.
* Develop automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
* Utilize modern DevOps and CI/CD practices to automate software builds, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Troubleshoot complex software issues and continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and performance
* Lead the team in executing planned sprint activities.
* Facilitate and lead all Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Retrospectives, and Reviews/Demos, using relevant metrics and data to drive continuous improvement.
* Actively remove impediments by resolving blocking issues related to feature development, build and dependency challenges, operational support conflicts, and process.
* Provide timely status, risk, and dependency reporting to the Release Lead and management, including sprint execution, team availability, and issues impacting delivery.
* Design, develop, document, configure, test, and debug applications and frameworks across the full software development life cycle, serving as a key contributor to system enhancements and new features.
* Assist with deployment, diagnosis, and resolution of critical issues in lab and operational systems as required.
* Collaborate with and mentor junior team members to meet sprint commitments and project milestones.
* Communicate effectively with cross-functional internal teams, stakeholders, and, when necessary, external partners to ensure alignment and successful delivery.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline with relevant professional software development experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 8+ years of relevant experience or a Master’s Degree and 6+ years of relevant experience
* Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to effectively collaborate with team members and present reports and status.
* Professional experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#.
* Experience with object-oriented programming, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and source control tools such as Git.
* Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, or distributed applications.
* Experience with modern software development methodologies and the SDLC.
* Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of cloud-based application development using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to or experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application development.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in the aviation industry or a similar high-tech field is a plus.
* Experience with large-scale distributed systems
* Experience working with safety critical or high availability software
* Experience integrating with legacy systems
* Experience reading and understanding large existing codebases
* Experience working in a global or multicultural environment is a plus
* Experience developing cloud-native applications and working with cloud-based AI services.
* Experience developing software in highly secure, regulated, mission-critical, or enterprise environments.

description:
**Position: Senior Automotive Software Requirements Engineer (Infotainment & Seating) (TT79ST RM 4533)**
**Experience Required**

* Total: 7–9 years
* Relevant: Minimum 3+ years in Automotive Infotainment, Automotive Seating, or Embedded Systems, including hands-on experience with seat-control features

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform requirement analysis and decomposition for infotainment features.
* Author and maintain software specifications with clear traceability.
* Manage traceability matrices across requirements, design, and test cases.
* Utilize DOORS DNG for requirement management and version control.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to define IVI architecture (head unit, middleware, apps).
* Design and validate HMI & UX principles for infotainment systems.
* Work on multimedia subsystems (audio, video, navigation).
* Integrate and validate vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, UDS, OBD II).
* Apply mid-level Functional Safety knowledge to software requirements, including ISO 26262 concepts, ASIL awareness, safety requirement decomposition, technical safety mechanisms, traceability, verification criteria, and support for safety analyses and reviews.
* Apply mid-level Automotive Cybersecurity knowledge to requirements engineering, including ISO/SAE 21434 concepts, Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) awareness, cybersecurity goals and requirements, secure diagnostics, secure communication, authentication, access control, secure boot, secure update, and cybersecurity verification criteria.
* Apply AUTOSAR knowledge during software requirement analysis and interface definition, including AUTOSAR Classic and Adaptive concepts, layered architecture, application software components, RTE, basic software, communication services, diagnostics, and ECU configuration dependencies.
* Provide technical leadership in embedded systems (Linux, QNX, Android Automotive).
* Analyze and decompose requirements for automotive seating functions, including lumbar support, side bolster adjustment, cushion extension/tilt, seat position and memory, heating, ventilation, and massage.
* Define and review seat-control system architecture and interfaces, including ECUs, motors, position sensors, switches, power management, network signals, and interactions with body-control and HMI systems.
* Specify and validate seat diagnostics and safety behavior, including actuator fault handling, position plausibility, obstruction/anti-pinch protection, thermal protection, voltage-related behavior, DTCs, and UDS diagnostic services.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders and apply system thinking to complex problems.

**Required Skills**

* Requirement analysis & decomposition
* Specification writing and documentation
* Traceability management (end to end requirement coverage)
* DOORS DNG and version management tools
* Automotive IVI domain knowledge
* IVI architecture (head unit, middleware, apps)
* HMI & UX principles
* Multimedia systems (audio, video, navigation)
* Vehicle communication protocols: CAN, LIN, Ethernet, UDS, OBD II
* Strong technical depth in embedded systems basics (Linux, QNX, Android Automotive)
* APIs, middleware, OS layers understanding
* AUTOSAR — mid-level proficiency: working knowledge of AUTOSAR Classic and awareness of AUTOSAR Adaptive, layered architecture, SWCs, ports and interfaces, RTE, BSW modules, COM stack, diagnostics, network management, ECU configuration, and interpretation of ARXML-based system and software descriptions
* Functional Safety — mid-level proficiency: working knowledge of ISO 26262, safety lifecycle concepts, ASIL classification, safety requirement analysis and decomposition, safety mechanisms, dependent failure awareness, bidirectional traceability, review support, and requirement-based verification
* Automotive Cybersecurity — mid-level proficiency: working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, cybersecurity lifecycle concepts, TARA outputs, cybersecurity goals and requirements, secure boot and software update, authentication and authorization, secure diagnostics and communication, key-management awareness, traceability, and cybersecurity verification
* Automotive seating domain knowledge, including lumbar, bolster, cushion, recline, slide, height, tilt, memory, easy-entry, heating, ventilation, and massage functions
* Seat ECU and mechatronic interface knowledge: DC/BLDC motors, Hall/position sensors, switches, motor drivers, current sensing, calibration, and end-stop learning
* Seating communication and diagnostics: CAN/LIN signals, network management, UDS, DTC definition, diagnostic routines, and EOL/service-tool requirements
* Seating safety and verification: anti-pinch/obstruction detection, thermal and electrical protection, degraded modes, requirement-based testing, and traceability to system and vehicle-level requirements
* Stakeholder communication and system thinking

**Preferred Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and mentor junior engineers.
* Experience in cross domain collaboration (hardware, software, UX).
* Exposure to OTA updates and connected services

title: QA AIML Consultant
description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation.
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest.
* Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing.
* Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers.
* Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate.
* Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis.
* Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows.
* Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders.
* Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon.
* Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation.
* Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams.

**Core Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies.
* Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles.
* Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams.
* Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access.

AI Testing Expertise
  
  

* Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates.
* Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone.
* Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge.
* Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage.
* Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse.
* Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery.
* Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies.
* Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems.
* Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.

title: Technical Lead - AI First Approach
description:
**Job: Technical Lead (AI-First | Strong Fundamentals | MVP Builder)**

At
**Infotech.Works**
, we partner with startups and innovators to turn raw ideas into working products—fast. Our projects typically move from idea to deployment in
**2–6 months**
, starting with rapid discovery and moving quickly into execution.

We’re looking for a
**Technical Lead**
who combines
**deep engineering fundamentals**
with
**AI-powered speed**
—someone who can design solid systems, make the right architectural trade-offs, and still ship fast.

This role is for someone who can
**think deeply and execute quickly**
.

**What You’ll Do**

* Translate business ideas into
  **robust technical architectures and system designs**
* Lead
  **discovery sessions**
  and create structured solution blueprints
* Design and build
  **MVPs that are fast to launch but don’t collapse at scale**
* Make key decisions on:
* Data models
* System boundaries
* API contracts
* Performance trade-offs
* Guide developers through
  **clean implementation, code quality, and design thinking**
* Introduce reusable patterns and
  **standardized architecture approaches**
* Use AI tools to accelerate development—
  **without compromising engineering quality**

**Core Requirement: Strong Engineering Fundamentals (Critical)**

We are
**not**
looking for surface-level developers who rely only on AI.

You must be strong in:

**Database Design**

* Schema design (normalized vs denormalized)
* Indexing strategies and query optimization
* Handling large datasets and performance bottlenecks
* Designing for reporting, analytics, and scalability
* Writing efficient SQL and understanding execution plans

**System Design & Architecture**

* Designing scalable, modular, and maintainable systems
* Clear understanding of:
* Monolith vs microservices (and when NOT to over-engineer)
* API design and contract-first thinking
* Caching strategies, queues, background jobs
* Ability to design systems that evolve from
  **MVP → scale without rework**

**Problem Solving**

* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured solutions
* Strong debugging and performance optimization skills

**AI-First Mindset (Equally Important)**

You should actively use AI to
**move faster**
, not to replace thinking.

* Daily use of tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor
* Ability to
  **learn new stacks quickly using AI-assisted workflows**
* Comfortable integrating APIs like OpenAI API into products
* Use AI for:
* Rapid prototyping
* Debugging
* Code generation
* Architecture exploration

The key difference:

You
**verify, refine, and improve AI output using strong fundamentals**

**Experience Required**

* 7–10 years of software development experience
* Proven track record of
  **shipping multiple MVPs or products end-to-end**
* Experience in
  **startup, product studio, or consulting environments preferred**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead small teams

**Technology Expectations**

**Backend**

* Laravel (PHP), Node.js (Express/Nest), or Python (Django/FastAPI)
* Strong API design and integration experience

**Frontend**

* React / Next.js / Vue
* Ability to quickly build functional, usable interfaces

**Cloud & DevOps**

* AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, SES, CloudWatch)
* Docker, CI/CD, Git

**Databases**

* Strong expertise in MySQL / PostgreSQL (must-have)
* Exposure to NoSQL is a plus

**Who You Are**

* You understand
  **why things work**
  , not just how to use them
* You can
  **design systems from scratch**
  , not just assemble components
* You are comfortable with ambiguity but
  **bring structure quickly**
* You move fast—but
  **never compromise on core design quality**
* You use AI as a
  **multiplier**
  , not a crutch

**Ideal Candidate Mindset**

“I can design the system, optimize the database, and ship the product. AI helps me go faster—but I know what good engineering looks like.”

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing
  **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with
  **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a
  **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**
  , ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Competitive compensation:**
  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:**
  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**
  up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:**
  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:**
  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:**
  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive.
  
  
NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team’s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release.
* Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end.
* Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done.
* Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model.
* Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes.

**What We Need To See**

* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track.
* 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering.
* High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team’s traditional capacity.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes.
* Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL.
* Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

title: Application Development Lead (Java) - Senior Vice President
description:
**Job Specification:**
We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team — the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1.5 billion risk calculations every day.
  
  
As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core — providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale.
  
  
Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability.
  
  
You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform:**
Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.
  
  
**Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team:**
Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards.
  
  
**Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work:**
Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning.
  
  
**Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine:**
Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250,000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput.
  
  
**Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone:**
Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Should be a Graduate from a recognized University
* 10+ years of professional software development experience with Java.
* Solid experience with Java frameworks (e.g., Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus).
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining large-scale, distributed systems.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with RESTful API design and implementation.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments, preferably in a leadership capacity.
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test automation frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Mockito).
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. * Lead end-to-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.

* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.

**Qualifications**

* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

**Skills**

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.

* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

**Location:**
Pune, IndiaWork Mode: Hybrid – Monday to Wednesday in-office, Thursday and Friday remote

**Experience:**
5+ years

**About InCommon**

InCommon helps global startups and businesses build, manage, and scale their teams in India.

We partner with growing companies to support their expansion through talent acquisition, Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup, compliance, payroll, and business operations.

Founded in 2023 and backed by Better Capital, InCommon works closely with companies to build strong teams across technology, AI, product, and leadership roles.

We are a strategic advisory and investment firm working with private equity firms, combining deep industry insights, strong relationships, and proprietary technology to create value across the investment lifecycle. We are building an in-house platform engineering capability where technology and automation play a critical role in driving business impact.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer – AI & Automation who combines strong Salesforce development skills with architectural thinking and hands-on ownership of enterprise system integrations.

In this role, you will own Salesforce solutions end-to-end, design integrations across multiple business systems, and use AI-powered development tools such as Claude and Claude Code to improve engineering efficiency. You will also drive development standards, CI/CD practices, automated testing, and technical collaboration across developers, QA, and business stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to build scalable systems, establish engineering best practices, and help shape an automation-first development environment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience across configuration and development, including Apex, LWC, SOQL, APIs, and administration.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modelling, automation patterns, and platform design.
* Experience designing and implementing integrations across enterprise systems using REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, middleware, SQL/NoSQL databases, and third-party platforms.
* At least 1 year of experience using AI coding tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows involving code review, automated testing, and controlled deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Git-based version control, branching strategies, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and Salesforce deployment tools such as SFDX or Gearset.
* Ability to guide developers and QA testers, review technical deliverables, and establish engineering standards.
* Active participation in Agile practices, including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and Google Apps Script for Google Workspace integrations is a plus.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud are preferred. Salesforce Architect certifications are an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution design, development, deployment, and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and SOQL queries.
* Design integration architecture across Salesforce and other enterprise systems.
* Use AI development tools to streamline requirements, coding, testing, and release workflows while ensuring code quality and production safety.
* Establish and maintain Git-based change control, code review standards, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Ensure configurations, code, and integrations are version-controlled, traceable, and auditable.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions in collaboration with the Product Manager and internal architect.
* Provide technical guidance to developers and QA teams, manage sprint execution, and support the growth of the Systems team.

**Tools & Platforms**

Candidates should be comfortable working across the following:

**● Salesforce - Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, custom objects and integrations**

**● Claude & Claude Code - primary AI development environment (enterprise license)**

**● Git-based version control - GitHub / Bitbucket, CI/CD pipelines, SFDX, Gearset or equivalent**

**● Google Workspace - Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Apps Script integrations**

**● Project management - Jira | Additional AI tooling Codex, GitHub Copilot, Agentforce**
