title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Delivery Manager to join us on an exciting journey as we modernize our core platforms to make them Simpler, Leaner and more Efficient. You will utilize your strong industry and domain expertise to shape up our Technology product offerings to meet the Business requirements for the future. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as a Technical Delivery Manager you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Experience in managing large multi-year complex projects involving global teams, through the full project lifecycle from inception to implementation.
* Collaborating with an experienced team of SMEs, Operations, Dev managers, and other Global Business stakeholders to understand the requirements and project deliverables.
* Managing Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies closely, across all aspects of the project.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, together with well-developed collaborative mindset.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Formal credentials in PMP/SAFE.
* Estimation skills for tasks, including design, development, technical debt, and testing.
* Exposure to Cloud Technologies (public or private).
* Understanding of any Liquidity Management or Core Banking Product suite.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To manage the efficient delivery of large-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Project Manager_3418
description:
**Role Description & Responsibilities**
*Are you energised by turning complex, multi-team technology programmes into predictable delivery for one of the world's largest financial services groups?*
*If so, this role puts you at the centre of that work. You will own the end-to-end delivery of projects across the Allianz Data Platform and the wider DAP portfolio, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure, translating complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables that engineering teams can act on.*
*The role sits at the crossroads of business, technology, and data, which means the governance you put in place, from risk and dependency management through to status reporting and escalation, shapes how thousands of colleagues across Allianz Group turn data into decisions.*
*To get there, you will facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams, and work alongside Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to keep delivery aligned with DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.*
*What we value most is your ability to bring structure to ambiguity, engage credibly with engineers on technical trade-offs, navigate stakeholders, product owners, and vendors, and coach the project managers coming up behind you.*
**As Part Of This Role You Will**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale data, analytics, and AI platform projects, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables, ensuring alignment between stakeholder expectations and engineering outcomes.
* Work closely with new and emerging technologies to improve platform usability, performance, and scalability across the DAP ecosystem.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, documentation, delivery, and ongoing maintenance, acting as the connective tissue between workstreams.
* Evaluate and make informed decisions around the adoption of new or existing technologies, tools, and project management methodologies.
* Define and maintain project governance frameworks, including risk management plans, dependency tracking, status reporting, and escalation paths.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams.
* Coach and mentor junior project managers and support the professional development of team members across the organisation.
* Collaborate with Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to contribute to and align with the DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, product owners, and external vendors or partners.
* Drive continuous improvement in project delivery practices, tooling, and team ways of working.

**✅ Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Master degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience in technical project management, with a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects, ideally within financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry.
* 1+ years of experience contributing to system design or architecture discussions (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling) within data, analytics, AI, or platform engineering contexts.
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycles and the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams on technical topics.
* Experience working with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, SQL, Bash) at a level sufficient to understand technical trade-offs and review technical documentation.
* Demonstrated experience in object-oriented or data-oriented programming concepts, enabling effective collaboration with development teams.
* Experience with end-to-end (E2E) Data Product Management, including data governance, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Strong command of agile project management methodologies, including SAFe, Scrum, and/or Kanban.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills in English (additional languages are a plus).

**⭐ Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in technical project management, ideally within data engineering, analytics platforms, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software environments.
* Experience managing the full software or data product development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing pipelines, and operational support.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe, or equivalent.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern data stack technologies (e.g., Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar).
* Experience working in a multinational or globally distributed organisation, ideally within financial services, insurance, or a regulated industry.

description:
**Overview:**
The Software Engineering Manager (M2) is responsible for providing leadership and day-to-day direction to a cross functional engineering team. This role involves establishing and executing operational plans, driving team process and technology productivity improvements, managing relationships with internal and external customers, and overseeing technical fulfillment projects. The manager also supports sales verticals in customer interactions and ensures the delivery of technology solutions aligns with business needs.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders including product, business and sales partners. Demonstrate excellent communication skills with the ability to both simplify complex problems and also dive deeper if needed
* Manage teams with cross functional skills that include software, quality, reliability engineers, project managers and scrum masters. Mentor, coach and develop junior and senior software, quality and reliability engineers. Collaborate with the architects, SRE leads and other technical leadership on strategic technical direction, guidelines, and best practices
* Ensure compliance with EFX secure software development guidelines and best practices and responsible for meeting and maintaining QE, DevSec, and FinOps KPIs.
* Define, maintain and report SLA, SLO, SLIs meeting EFX engineering standards in partnership with the product, engineering and architecture teams
* Drive technical documentation including support, end user documentation and run books. Lead Production Support processes, Sprint planning, Sprint Retrospectives and other team activities
* Implement architecture decision making associated with Product features/stories, refactoring work, and EOSL decisions
* Create and deliver technical presentations to internal and external technical and non-technical stakeholders communicating with clarity and precision, and present complex information in a concise format that is audience appropriate
* Provides coaching, leadership and talent development; ensures teams functions as a high-performing team; able to identify performance gaps and opportunities for upskilling and transition when necessary.
* Drives culture of accountability through actions and stakeholder engagement and expectation management
* Develop the long-term technical vision and roadmap within, and often beyond, the scope of your teams.
* Oversee systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and review product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems
* Identify and resolve problems affecting day-to-day operations
* Set priorities for the engineering team and coordinate work activities with other supervisors
* Cloud Certification Strongly Preferred

**What experience you need:**

* BS or MS degree in a STEM major or equivalent job experience required
* 10+ years’ experience in software development and delivery
* You adore working in a fast paced and agile development environment
* You possess excellent communication, sharp analytical abilities, and proven design skills
* You have detailed knowledge of modern software development lifecycles including CI / CD
* You have the ability to operate across a broad and complex business unit with multiple stakeholders
* You have an understanding of the key aspects of finance especially as related to Technology. Specifically including total cost of ownership and value
* You are a self-starter, highly motivated, and have a real passion for actively learning and researching new methods of work and new technology
* You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with team members at various levels, including business leaders

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Experience managing Kanban processes, and various techniques to prioritize critical issues or features in a customer-support setting.
* Experience working with AI tooling (e.g. Gemini CodeAssist, GitHub CoPilot)
* UI development (e.g. HTML, JavaScript, AngularJS, Angular4/5 and Bootstrap)
* Source code control management systems (e.g. SVN/Git, Subversion) and build tools like Maven
* Big Data, Postgres, Oracle, MySQL, NoSQL databases (e.g. Cassandra, Hadoop, MongoDB, Neo4J)
* Design patterns
* Agile environments (e.g. KanBan, Scrum, XP)
* Software development best practices such as TDD (e.g. JUnit), automated testing (e.g. Gauge, Cucumber, FitNesse), continuous integration (e.g. Jenkins, GoCD)
* Linux command line and shell scripting languages
* Relational databases (e.g. SQL Server, MySQL)
* Cloud computing, SaaS (Software as a Service)
* Atlassian tooling (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, and Bitbucket)
* Experience working in financial services
* Experience working with open source frameworks; preferably Spring, though we would also consider Ruby, Apache Struts, Symfony, Django, etc.
* Automated Testing: JUnit, Selenium, LoadRunner, SoapUI

**Behaviors:**

* Customer-focused with a drive to exceed expectations.
* Demonstrates integrity and accountability.
* Intellectually curious and driven to innovate.
* Values diversity and fosters collaboration.
* Results-oriented with a sense of urgency and agility.

* Researches, develops, and implements automation techniques to improve development efficiency and system sustainability.

* Analyzes and supports system requirements related to security, backup, recovery, restart, controls, and data integrity, recommending appropriate technical solutions.

description:

 Test Case Preparation

* Validate that new changes do not impact existing functionalities

Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment

* Monitor software products and development processes for conformance to quality standards, identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain compliance across the software development lifecycle.
* Conduct root cause analyses on quality failures, document findings with precision, and independently recommend process improvements that elevate team\-wide quality outcomes.
* Analyze complex trade data — including order types and execution flows — to validate system behavior and ensure alignment with FIX protocol and electronic trading regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate test strategy development and execution across project teams, global stakeholders, and third\-party vendors, ensuring consistent delivery against timelines and quality benchmarks.

* 10 or more years of experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience testing trading platforms, with a solid understanding of Futures and Options products, order types, and electronic trading processes.
* Proficiency in test automation using Java and Behavior\-Driven Development frameworks, specifically Cucumber, with the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments (ECS), and version control using GitHub, enabling integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows.
* Good understanding of the FIX protocol, regulatory obligations for electronic trading, and the ability to validate system behavior against these standards.
* Ability to write complex queries and work with reporting tools to analyses large volumes of trade and system data effectively.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across project teams, vendors, and global counterparts to align on quality outcomes.

 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Software Integration Engineer
   

  

**Overview**
 The SME team is looking for a Lead Software Integration Engineer who can independently contribute in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, collaboration, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, and workflow management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices that enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. The role also involves partnering with engineering teams to evaluate source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding best practices.
   

  

 This position designs, executes, and maintains tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, enhance customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
   

  

 The role requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can informally coach others and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Design and maintain integration tests for systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to clarify requirements, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability.
* Lead UI, API, backend, integration, and performance automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Gatling, and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, environments, and networks.
* Analyze workflows, remove bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, and adapt processes to improve delivery.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership while promoting continuous improvement.


**All About You / Experience**
 The ideal candidate for this position should have:
   

  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and validation across complex technology programs.
* Hands\-on experience with UI, API, backend, and integration automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Strong experience in API integration testing, backend validation, web services, and system interoperability.
* Experience with API performance testing and tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across systems, applications, services, environments, and networks.
* Working knowledge of Git, Jira, XRay, Insomnia, and cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Ability to lead teams, support proof\-of\-concepts, mentor others, and influence scalable quality practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proactive, adaptable, continuous\-improvement mindset.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Sr Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Internationalization Software Engineer**
**About The Job**
 The Globalization Experience Team is searching for an Internationalization Software Engineer responsible for creating, enhancing, and maintaining robust software and tooling so SAS products work correctly for global users across languages, locales, and character sets. This role focuses on building and integrating foundational internationalization capabilities—Unicode correctness, locale‑sensitive formatting and sorting, and string externalization/resource management—while partnering with product teams to embed best practices early in the software development cycle. You’ll also use AI\-assisted techniques (when appropriate) to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation, helping teams deliver global\-ready software efficiently and consistently.
   

  

**As An Internationalization AI Software Developer, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain software, libraries, and tooling that enable product teams to efficiently build high‑quality, global‑ready software in compliance with SAS Internationalization guidelines and standards.
* Work effectively in mature and legacy code to resolve customer\-impacting defects, coordinating with support and product teams to deliver patch updates for high\-priority fixes with strong testing and regression awareness to protect production behavior
* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders—including product development teams, product managers, project managers, support engineers, and testers—to integrate internationalization best practices early and throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with internationalization testers to guide testing strategies, investigate defects, and drive engineering improvements that result in high‑quality, globally usable product deliverables.
* Use AI\-assisted tools responsibly as part of day‑to‑day engineering (e.g., accelerating code review and refactoring suggestions, log/defect triage, test generation, and documentation) while ensuring correctness, traceability, and alignment with SAS development standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a software developer, with hands‑on experience applying internationalization best practices and working with industry‑standard libraries such as ICU and CLDR.
* Experience using modern developer productivity tools (including AI\-assisted coding and review tools) to improve delivery speed and quality, with an understanding of validation practices (tests, reviews, and responsible use).
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Python, and C, with the ability to read, understand, and contribute to production codebases.
* Working proficiency in shell scripting (e.g., Bash or similar) to support automation, tooling, or development workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional teams including developers, testers, and product stakeholders.
* Hands‑on experience using GitHub in a team environment, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence as part of an Agile development process, including issue tracking, planning, and documentation.
* Ability to adjust working hours to accommodate a variety of time zones
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.


**Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience with SAS programming or familiarity with SAS language, tools, or development environments.
* Experience with TypeScript and Java Script a plus.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, or deployment automation.
* Proficiency in additional spoken language.

title: Senior Manager, IT Program Management
description:
Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards Lifesciences, we're dedicated to developing ground\-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting\-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient\-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions.
   

  

 The Anaplan Center of Excellence (CoE) owns a portfolio of 50\+ connected planning applications used across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. As Sr. Project Manager, you will orchestrate the delivery of new applications and the continuous enhancement of the existing portfolio, working with a globally distributed team of developers and administrators and with business partners across multiple functions and time zones.
   

  

**How you'll make an impact:**
* Orchestrate a portfolio of concurrent Anaplan initiatives – new application builds and enhancement/update releases – across multiple use case families (e.g., financial planning \& analysis, commercial and sales planning, operational planning), balancing priorities, dependencies, and shared resources across 50\+ applications.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery: intake and business case, detailed requirements definition, scoping, planning, build coordination, testing/UAT, deployment, and hypercare, using a hybrid delivery methodology (Agile sprints for build, stage\-gate/Waterfall controls for planning and release).
* Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery of a distributed CoE team – 8–11 Anaplan developers in Pune and administrator resources in Prague and the US – without direct people\-management responsibility: plan sprints and releases, remove blockers, manage capacity and sequencing across projects.
* Partner with the enterprise data team on data integration requirements, source availability, and interface timelines; align delivery plans with data pipeline readiness.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with finance partners, commercial stakeholders, and other business functions; manage expectations, translate business priorities into a realistic delivery roadmap, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs transparently.
* Maintain the CoE delivery roadmap and release calendar; manage changes to scope, schedule, and cost so plans remain accurate and reflect authorized changes.
* Actively manage project risks and issues; monitor performance, identify and quantify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Facilitate creation and approval of business cases and prioritization decisions, using historical data and expert judgment to understand constraints.
* Strengthen CoE delivery governance: standardize intake, estimation, status reporting, and release management practices; lead continuous improvement of PM processes within the CoE.
* Manage project closure activities, including lessons learned, and drive resulting improvements into future releases.
* Serve as a project management subject matter expert within the CoE; guide and mentor team members on delivery practices.
* Other incidental duties.


**What you'll need (Required):**
* Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
* A minimum of eight years of hands\-on experience managing software delivery projects of increasing complexity, or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria.
* Project Management Professional (PMP); if not, Green Belt, Black Belt, or Scrum Master certification.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery with globally distributed teams and cross\-functional business stakeholders.
* Experience running hybrid delivery models (Agile/Scrum combined with Waterfall/stage\-gate governance).
* This role is not a remote position. It requires onsite presence at the Edwards IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India, working second shift with overlap to European (CET) and partial US working hours.


**What else we look for (Preferred):**
* Experience delivering Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / connected planning implementations on any platform (e.g., Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion/EPM Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud/BPC, OneStream, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment).
* Understanding of planning processes in finance (budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning) and/or commercial functions (sales forecasting, quota and territory planning).
* Experience working alongside data engineering teams on integrations (ETL/ELT, APIs, data hubs).
* Demonstrated experience with SDLC project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps) and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet).
* Proven expertise in MS Office Suite and related project management systems.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and relationship management, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives.

We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **Senior Production Support \& Enhancement Engineer** 
 to manage end\-to\-end application development, maintenance, and production support for Java/Oracle\-based enterprise systems. Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands\-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.
   

  

 This role is primarily focused on
 **60% development and enhancement activities** 
 and
 **40% production support and maintenance** 
 , requiring a strong balance of technical expertise and functional understanding. The ideal candidate will ensure high system availability while contributing to new feature development, custom change requests, POCs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and enhance Java\-based enterprise applications and backend services.
* Implement new features, custom change requests (CRs), and technical enhancements aligned with business requirements.

* Write, optimize, and maintain SQL/PL\-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects in Oracle.
* Participate in solution design discussions, technical feasibility analysis, and Proof\-of\-Concept (POC) initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs) including performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Provide L2/L3 production support by monitoring applications, analyzing logs, and resolving incidents within SLA timelines.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and implement permanent fixes.
* Coordinate with business users during requirement clarification, UAT cycles, and issue resolution.
* Handle service requests, defect fixes, deployment support, and release activities.
* Collaborate with QA, infrastructure, and cross\-functional teams to ensure system stability and smooth operations.
* Maintain proper documentation for incidents, changes, enhancements, and deployment activities.
* Contribute to automation, scripting, and operational efficiency improvements where applicable.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Strong experience in Java (Core Java, Spring/Spring Boot)
* Solid hands\-on experience with Oracle Database (SQL, PL/SQL, performance tuning)
* Experience in REST API development and backend services
* Knowledge of enterprise application architecture
* Experience in application production support (incident management, RCA, SLA handling)
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments
* Experience with version control tools (Git) and build tools (Maven)
* Working knowledge of ticketing tools (JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)

 We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work\-life balance!  Hope to hear from you soon!
   

  

 Location: Pune
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  




**Description**
 ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next\-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
   

  

 Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud\-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and \- through our product SIMS \- collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.
   

  

 ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.
   

  

 Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Development** 
 : design, code, test, and debug software solutions in accordance with project specifications. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
   

**Coding and Documentation:** 
 write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code. Maintain comprehensive documentation for code and software features.
   

**Front end web development** 
 : ability to design, create and evolve user\-facing applications to be scalable, maintainable, secure, aesthetic and usable within the constraints imposed by the browser using a combination of languages, design skills, and client\-side scripts and frameworks.
   

**Backend development** 
 : ability to write, maintain and design the business logic of a software application, the data or services requested are available as well as create and maintain the core databases, data and application program interfaces (APIs) to other backend processes.
   

**Database Management** 
 : knowledge of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle). Competence in writing and optimizing SQL queries.
   

**Version Control** 
 : proficient in using the Git version control systems.
   

**Testing and Debugging** 
 : experience with testing frameworks (e.g. XUnit) and debugging tools.
   

 Knowledge of test\-driven development (TDD) principles.
   

**DevOps** 
 : basic understanding of DevOps practices, continuous integration, and deployment.
   

**Cloud Computing** 
 : familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
   

**Collaboration:** 
 work closely with team members to understand project requirements and collaborate on project goals. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
   

**Adaptability** 
 : stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. Adapt to new tools, languages, and methodologies as required by projects.
   

**Quality Assurance:** 
 implement coding standards to ensure high\-quality, bug\-free code.
   

**Development Principles** 
 : implement industry standard development principles and frameworks for achieving quality, speed and maintainability. This includes the practices, techniques and tools that support those principles, and an understanding of when things may or may not be applicable in a situation or context.
   

**Giving and Receiving Feedback** 
 : solicit and engage with feedback on a continuous basis. Having timely, actionable and meaningful conversations about quality and performance for the purpose of improving effectiveness.
   

**Emotional Intelligence** 
 : recognizes, understands and manages their own emotions and recognizes, understands, shares and influences the emotions of others. Collaboration: works jointly with others to co\-create and achieve a common goal. This includes learning, practising and experimenting with tools, techniques and frameworks that foster collaborative working environments.
   

**Ownership and Accountability** 
 : takes personal accountability and ownership for their work. This includes personal follow through, making and defending difficult decisions and tradeoffs, removing blockers, driving collective progress.
   

**Continuous Improvement** 
 : advances by ongoing, incremental improvement through continuous learning, questioning the status quo and trying out creative and novel ideas. Shows curiosity and has a keen interest to drive learning for themselves and others.
   

**Systems Thinking** 
 : Positively impact complex systems or domains by understanding the whole picture and the interdependencies of its component parts. Maintain strong expertise and knowledge of current and emerging technologies and products.
   

  

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 • Communication skills (both written and verbal) demonstrated at all levels of the organisation
   

 • Software development skills (.NET Framework, .NET Core, C\#, VB.Net, React, MVC, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Xamarin, Java / XCode)
   

 • Cloud computing, particularly Microsoft Azure, with experience of deploying and managing applications in the cloud
   

 • RESTful API development
   

 • Testing framework knowledge (XUnit, Moq) and test driven development experience
   

 • Experience of source code control and release management (CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps)
   

 • Knowledge of API testing (Postman).
   

 • Database management, extensive query skills and ORM (Entity Framework) experience
   

 • Agile development methodologies: Kanban, Scrum, XP, Lean.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* Manual testing (functional \+ UX validation)
* Automation testing (efficiency \+ speed)
* Program coordination (APM responsibilities)


**1\. Manual Testing Responsibilities**
* Analyze requirements, user stories, and BRDs
* Create test cases, scenarios, and checklists
* Perform functional testing
* Perform UI/UX testing
* Perform exploratory and ad\-hoc testing
* Validate business flows and user journeys
* Identify and log defects with proper steps and impact
* Perform regression testing manually (small scope)


**2\. Automation Testing Responsibilities**
* Identify test cases suitable for automation
* Develop automation scripts (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, etc.)
* Build and maintain automation frameworks
* Execute automated regression test suites
* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Perform API testing
* Perform performance and load testing
* Analyze automation results and maintain dashboards


**3\. Test Planning \& Strategy (Senior Analyst Role)**
* Define test strategy (manual \+ automation mix)
* Create test plans, timelines, and effort estimation
* Decide what to automate vs. what to test manually
* Ensure test coverage across modules
* Track test metrics (pass %, defect density, coverage)
* Participate in requirement reviews and risk analysis
* Contribute to quality standards and best practices


**4\. Delivery \& Program Management (APM Role)**
* Track testing progress vs sprint/release timelines
* Manage defect triage and prioritization
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, and production releases
* Monitor test execution dashboards and reports
* Ensure quality sign\-off before releases
* Identify and mitigate project risks
* Support sprint planning, stand\-ups, and governance calls


**5\. Defect \& Quality Management**
* Log defects with clear steps, severity, and impact
* Track defect lifecycle: New → Assigned → Fixed → Retested → Closed
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA)
* Ensure zero leakage to production
* Maintain quality reports for stakeholders and audits


**6\. Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work with developers, product owners, business analysts, and clients
* Translate business requirements into test scenarios
* Provide quality insights and release readiness reports
* Act as QA SPOC for client communications


**Technical Skills**
* Manual testing (test cases, defect management)
* Automation tools: Selenium / Playwright / Cypress
* Programming basics: Java / Python / JavaScript
* API testing (Postman, RestAssured)
* Database (SQL)
* CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps)
* Test management tools: Jira / QC / TestRail


**QA Skills**
* Test case design techniques
* Regression and exploratory testing
* Automation framework understanding
* Risk\-based testing
* Quality metrics analysis


**Project / APM Skills**
* Sprint tracking and planning
* Status reporting
* Risk and issue management
* Stakeholder coordination
* Release management


**Soft Skills**
* Strong attention to detail
* Communication (technical \+ business)
* Analytical thinking
* Ownership mindset
* Team collaboration


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Certifications (Optional): ISTQB, Agile / Scrum


**Key Deliverables**
* Test plans \& strategies
* Test cases (manual \+ automation)
* Automation scripts \& frameworks
* Defect logs \& dashboards
* Test execution reports

title: Director, Technical Program Management’
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Technical Program Management’
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 Mastercard’s Business \& Market Insights (B\&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth \& innovation goals by providing unparalleled data\-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B\&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
   

  

 We are currently looking for a ‘Director, Technical Program Management’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence program within B\&MI, to provide program management leadership, cutting across different product areas.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Successfully lead major projects and complex assignments with broad scope and long\-term business implications. Collaborate with business and technical partners to scope the opportunities, outline potential value and ROI, and identify risks, benefits and constraints.
* Be the owner for all Program\-level initiatives while also ensuring success of individual delivery teams. Provide people leadership to technical program managers across the program.
* Assist in examining commercially available and forthcoming industry technologies related to area of expertise. Research on current and upcoming technologies and application frameworks and provide recommendations. Proactively create and maintain solution and technology roadmaps.
* Create detailed cost and time estimates for implementing business solutions, define technical scope and requirements of the project and assist your team with managing scope during the lifecycle of the project. Identify Program quality methodologies, define and track quality metrics and ensure continued process quality improvement within the program.
* Manage multiple scrum teams and be responsible to organize and lead all Agile/SAFe ceremonies. Be accountable for overall progress of the committed projects and enhance processes to streamline deliveries. Champion in tracking initiatives progress/reports using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally.
* Develop good technical understanding of product architecture \& flows and be able to propose technical solutions. Possess hands\-on technical capabilities to track, analyse or resolve critical issues and customer queries.
* Effectively manage internal and external stakeholders and participate in technical discussions as a program representative.
* Help customers and the product/engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.


  
   

  

**All About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent work experience, with a proven track\-record of successfully leading and managing complex programs/projects/products.
* Advanced level understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies with a demonstrated experience in organizing Agile/SAFe ceremonies, planning program \& iteration deliverables, leading scrum meetings, managing cost \& effort estimation and driving prioritization discussions.
* A solid foundation in Computer Science, with prior hands\-on experience on .Net stack and/or Java stack (preferably on web applications and microservices\-based software architecture and with an exposure to cloud technologies). Strong SQL skills would be a huge plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal) and experience with managing internal and external stakeholders at all management levels.

title: Senior Software Integration Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Software Integration Engineer
   

  

**Overview**
 The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards.
   

  

 This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
   

  

 The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
* Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.
* Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC.
* Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable.
* Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services.
* Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools.
* Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
* Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof\-of\-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.


**All About You / Experience**
 The ideal candidate for this position should have:
   

  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.
* Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals.
* Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress.
* Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation.
* Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions.
* Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks.
* Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems.
* Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes.
* Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia.
* Experience with test case management tools such as XRay.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators.
* Ability to work on proof\-of\-concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly.
* Self\-driven, proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement.
